cases.prompt: 이 Python race condition을 고칠 모델을 추천해줘. 지금은 코드 수정 없이 추천만 해줘.

assertions.text: Classifies CODE_FIX and uses the central planner's reasoning/code floor rather than a static model winner
Sets writes false because this request is advice only and does not launch a worker
Reports an evidence-bound route with registry fingerprint and requested effort, or explicit missing-runtime reasons; never fabricates a benchmark score

cases.prompt: 이 1000페이지 문서의 X 주제를 조사 요약할 모델을 골라줘.

assertions.text: Classifies RESEARCH with research and reasoning requirements and checks usable document/context/tool support from evidence
Does not treat a Wiki last-updated timestamp or a claimed context size as sufficient current routing evidence

cases.prompt: Best model to scrape a site? An authorized read-only API is already available.

assertions.text: Prefers the authorized API; does not dispatch COMPUTER_USE or a Bot solely because the task mentions a site
If using a local step, keeps exact argv cost verification instead of assuming that a wrapper is free

cases.prompt: 추가 과금 $0. Grok 주간 100%, 추가 한도와 잔액 0이야. 다음 모델로 알아서 진행해.

assertions.text: Keeps Grok CLI generation on hold until fresh quota recovery evidence, without top-up or overage changes
Only returns another route when registry/runtime/effort/account/cost gates pass; unknown billing is not zero and the host model is not an automatic fallback

cases.prompt: /vibe의 기존 run에서 simonk가 구현 2개와 코드 리뷰를 배치하려고 해. 부모 예산은 $0이야.

assertions.text: Reuses the parent run_id, budget and ancestor_skills, and does not create a second coordinator or independent per-task budgets
Keeps writes true, verify_of and depends_on in one DAG with different-vendor review; returns the unchanged canonical plan instead of a legacy launcher config

cases.prompt: 승인된 API나 CLI가 없는 관리 화면에서 표시된 값을 읽어줘. 화면만 확인하고 변경은 하지 마.

assertions.text: Uses COMPUTER_USE only with explicit target, gui_reason, tool_route_available false and vibe-bot skill; keeps writes false
Requires Bot-specific availability/billing/quota evidence and does not invent model or reasoning-effort controls
